en.answer: A face-down monster can be used as Fusion Material when resolving <<11504>>, as long as it is an appropriate Fusion Material monster for the Fusion Monster you wish to Special Summon.
en.question: When resolving the effect of <<11504>>, can I use a face-down Defense Position monster on my side of the field as Fusion Material?
